yt_description:
Still managing properties on spreadsheets? Missed renewals. Lost leads. Rent chaos.

Stackby turns your spreadsheets into a real Property Portal: leads, listings, leases and rentals — commercial and residential, one portal. Import your sheet, every row becomes a record, and your portal is live in minutes. Or just describe what you need and Stackby AI builds it.

👉 Build your property portal, free to start: https://stackby.com/signup

What's inside
• Listings
• Lead CRM
• Lease Management
• Rent Collection
• Owner & Tenant Portal

Why teams switch
✅ Whole portfolio, one view: every property, unit and lease — live.
✅ Never miss a renewal: automatic reminders before leases end.
✅ Owner & tenant portals: each party sees only what's theirs.
✅ Real-time rent roll: collections and arrears, always current.
